lines.original: Don't you know that I want to be more than just your friend
lines.translation: 难道你不知，我不只想当你的朋友而已

lines.original: I've got better things on my mind
If you'd only see me in a different light
lines.translation: 假如你用不同的眼光看我

lines.original: Baby when we finally get together
lines.translation: 宝贝当我们最终走到一起

lines.original: You would see that I was right
I'd be yours and you'll be mine
If you'd only say you love me
don't treat me like I was ice
lines.translation: 我属于你 你也属于我

lines.original: I'd be yours and you'll be mine
lines.translation: 我会是你的 你将属于我

lines.original: If you'd only say you love me darling
You would see that I was right
lines.translation: 你会发现我是对的那个人

lines.original: If you'd only say you love me Luna
You would see that I was right
